messages:
From: samir.patel@brightridge.io
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: onboarding@brightridge.io
Date: 2026-10-25T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding: initial tax packet and invoice entity

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick turnaround on onboarding. Attached is our standard W-9 for BrightRidge Technologies (EIN ends in -92). A couple of things to flag so we don’t slow the PO:

- The W-9 is in the parent-company name (BrightRidge Technologies). We typically invoice from a local operating unit (BrightRidge Solutions, DBA BrightRidge Consulting).
- For ACH we can provide a redacted bank letter; our bank prefers to redact account numbers for emailed copies.

If Redwood requires the W-9 to reflect the invoicing entity rather than the parent, we can either: (a) provide a new W-9 for BrightRidge Solutions, or (b) complete a short DBA attestation form signed by our CFO so you can accept invoices from the subsidiary.

I’ve attached the W-9 and a placeholder ACH letter. Let me know which path is required and we’ll get the signed affidavit back the same day.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Head of Finance — BrightRidge Technologies
Attachments: BrightRidge_W9_signed.pdf (application/pdf); BrightRidge_ACH_BankLetter_redacted.pdf (application/pdf)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-25T10:03:00-04:00
Subject: Fwd: Vendor onboarding: initial tax packet and invoice entity

Kim / Jordan,

Forwarding BrightRidge’s packet — they sent a parent-company W-9 but plan to invoice from a subsidiary (DBA). Procurement policy requires the W-9 to match the remit-to entity on the PO. We have three acceptable paths here:

1) Request vendor to provide a W-9 in the invoicing entity name (BrightRidge Solutions).
2) Accept parent W-9 plus a signed DBA attestation (we treat as acceptable evidence for PO).
3) Capture parent W-9 and route for legal sign-off for a one-off exception if supplier refuses to reissue.

Operational notes: Coupa requires the legal name on the vendor account to match the W-9/EIN. Workday PO generation also validates remit-to. If we accept a DBA attestation, we need: signed attestation (PDF), redacted ACH letter, and an internal procurement note tying the DBA to the parent EIN.

Recommend asking them for option (2) to avoid delays. Can you confirm that finance is comfortable with DBA attestation + redacted bank letter for ACH setup? If yes, I’ll ask Samir for the attestation form filled and signed and then we’ll queue the PO.

-Karthik
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
